item.title: Nearly 200 people massacred by gunmen in Kaiama LGA, Nigeria
item.description: Security experts and human rights organizations have linked the cause of the attacks to porous borders, reactive security approach, and spillover of extremist groups.

item.title: Russian full-scale invasion of Ukraine has now lasted 1,462 days. 48 months. 4 years.
item.description: As of February 24, 2026, this is already 44 days longer than the Second World War (Eastern Front) lasted for the Soviet Union.

item.title: Cambodian police arrest journalist for reporting on online scam center
item.description: "The arrest and charging of this journalist is yet another incident that demonstrates the government’s tendency to silence members of the press through the misuse of criminal law."

item.title: ‘Shame must change sides’: Gisèle Pelicot’s tremendous message of hope and courage sweeps the world
item.description: After learning her now ex-husband arranged for her to be raped by 50 men while unconscious, Gisèle Pelicot wrote a memoir, documenting her struggle and current state of mind.

item.title: Iran’s digital prison was built with the help of Russians
item.description: The Russian company Protei supplied the Iranian regime with infrastructure-level internet censorship solutions. They also work in Estonia and Jordan, and have clients from among the world’s worst autocracies.

item.title: The marble mirage: Ashgabat’s record-breaking facade contradicts Turkmenistan’s reality
item.description: The regime uses this "White City" as a visual tool to project power and stability to the outside world, masking the country’s deep isolation.

item.title: ‘Are refugees being traded?’ UN questions the UK-France asylum swap
item.description: A “one in, one out” deal linking deportations to legal admissions draws criticism for detentions, force and risks of refoulement.

item.title: ’A reading group produces conversation, surprise, challenge, emotional commitment‘: Reading in the AI Era
item.description: Reading is a space where chronological time is replaced by another one, a mental time that surrenders the rhythm of what's read.

item.title: Healing a region: How healthcare is bringing peace to Arauca, Colombia
item.description: Reliable, inclusive healthcare does more than treat illness. It can function as social glue that softens community strain and transforms clinics into safe spaces for everyone.

item.title: Hongkonger fights in Ukraine as diaspora marks grim anniversary
item.description: Four years since Russia’s full-scale invasion of Ukraine, a Hong Kong volunteer soldier battles in Ukraine while the local Ukrainian community grieves from afar.
